basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 25-year-old pet enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. I recently rediscovered my love for Webkinz from my childhood and decided to join the community to share and trade codes. Besides Webkinz, I'm a big fan of indie video games, particularly 'The Binding of Isaac', which I play during evenings after work. I work as a graphic designer during the day and am in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my interest in gaming and collectibles. You can usually find me online during the late evening hours, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design from a local college and have been working in the field for three years. My interest in indie games and collectibles mostly comes from self-teaching and being part of online communities. I love learning about new games and collectibles from fellow enthusiasts.
